content: Iyo7aasi Xoossa Keeththaza Ooraxiso
Iyuy kawotida laappunththa layththan Iyo7aasi kawotides; izi Yerusalaamen uttidi 40 layth haarides; iza aaya Sabiyo geetettizaara Bersaabehe kataman yelettadus.
Qeese Yoodahey tamaarsiza wode ubbaan Iyo7aasi GODAA sinththan lo7o miish ooththides.
Gido attiin zumbullata bollan goynnizasohota dhayssibeenna; derezikka he sohotan yarsho shiishonne exaane cuwaseth gujji gujji bides.
Iyo7aasi qeeseta, «Dereza qoodan shiiqida miishshaa, adinan gelida miishshaa qasseka asay ba shenen GODAA Keeththas immida dumma dumma miishshaa ubbaa issiso shiishshite.
Qeeseti issoy issoy miishshaza shiishshizayta kusheppe ekketto; he miishshazi koshshiza mala Xoossa Keeththa giddon moorettida sohota ooraxissana kezo» gides.
Gido attiin Iyo7aasi kawotiin biidi nam7u tammanne heedzdzanththo layththi gakkanaas qeeseti Xoossa Keeththaza garsan moorettida sohota ooraxissibeettenna.

Hessa gishshas Iyo7aasi qeese Yoodahenne hara qeesetakka baakko xeygi shiishshidi, «Ays Xoossa Keeththa giddon moorettidayta zaari lo7eththontta aggidetii?» gi oychchides. Qasseka, «Hayssafe sinththan miishshay Xoossa Keeththaza giddon moorettidayssa ooraxissanaas kezo attiin miishsha oykkiza asatappe ekkofte» gides.
Qeesetikka hessafe guye deraappe miishshe shiishshontta malanne Xoossa Keeththaaka banttarkka ooraxissontta mala qaala qachchida.

Hessafe guye qeese Yoodahey issi saaxine ekkidi izas kamaza lukkidi xoo7e kessides; efidi Xoossa Keeththan gelizasoppe ushachcha baggara yarsho yarshizasohoza achchan woththides. Kareza naagiza qeesetikka Xoossa Keeththas yiza miish ubbaaka he saaxinezan gelththeettes.
Saaxineza giddon daro miishshi dizayssa beyi be7idi kawoza xaafezinne qeeseta halaqay yiidi yiidi Xoossa Keeththas yida miishshaa qoodi qoodidi karaxiiten gelththi qachchi woththeettes.
He miishshaza meezaaney erettidaappe guye GODAA Keeththaza ooso alaafeteththan oosisana mala miishshazi doorettida asatas imettees; hessika Xoossa Keeththaa keexxiza anaaxetas, gimbe gimbizaytas,
shuch massizaytas, shuchchafe dumma dumma medha giigsizaytassinne Xoossa Keeththaa ooraxissanaas miththassinne masettida shuchchas kezees.
Xoossa Keeththazas gelida miishshafe gidikko Xoossa Keeththas soo giddo oosos koshshiza bira xuu7ata, tama qapheta, distteta, dinketanne hara worqqafe gidiin birappe oosettiza miishshatas kezibeenna.
He miishshafe Xoossa Keeththaza ooraxissizaytas xalla qanxxettides.
Keeththaa ooraththiza asatas miish qanxxanaas doorettida asati mulera ammanettidayta gidida gishshas istta kaalli xeellizaade koshshibeenna.
Qoho gishshas shiiqiza yarshoynne nagara gishshas shiiqiza yarshoy gidikko hayti qeesetas gidida gishshas Xoossa Keeththaa gelettenna.
He wode Aaraame kawo Azaheeley kezidi Geete bolla meto gaththidi izo oykkides; qasseka Yerusalaame bolla meto yegganaas hee simmides.

Yuhuda kawo Iyo7aasi gidikko kase iza aawati Yuhuda kawoti Iyoosaafixey, Iyoraamey, Akaziyaasi Xoossas dumma shaakkida miishshata ubbaa izi barkka shaakki woththida dummatida imotata hessaththoka Xoossa Keeththaninne kawo miishshata woththiza minjja keeththan beettida worqqa ubbaa issi bolla shiishshidi Aaraame kawo Azaheeles yeddides; Azaheeley Yerusalaame yuus aggidi guye simmides.
Iyo7aasi ba kawoteththa layththatan ooththida hara oosotinne izi polida hanoti ubbay Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Iza shuumetikka iza bolla dendida; duge Sila woththiza ogeza bolla Betemiloonen iza wodhida.
Iza wodhidaytikka shuumeti Shim7aata naa Yozakaarenne Shomereye naa Yozabaade; izi hayqqidi kase ba aawata ubbata mala Dawite katamaan moogettides; iza naa Amasiyaasi izasohon kawotides.
